answer: Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 5 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the quartz. Promotion is logged in walnut and juniper recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, which means a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 253 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
